messages:
maya: ProtonAI opened SUP-8811 — they spotted a $7.2k burst on their Dedicated commit for Feb (INV-4019). Asking for an audit + refund.
trevor-fin: paste invoice lines?
maya: INV-4019 snippet:
```
INV-4019
- Reserved commit (Feb): $8,500
- Burst overage (02/22 04:12-04:37 UTC): $7,200
Total due: $15,700
```
platform-bot: Alert: autoscaler-duplication detected 2026-02-22T04:11Z. Two scale events triggered concurrently due to race in allocator; duplicate node provisioning recorded (internal incident INC-2026-214).
trevor-fin: If duplicate nodes were provisioned and billed, that looks non-customer-caused. We need a quick audit of billed GPU-hours vs actual legitimate extra capacity.
maya: I'll pull the metering. Give me 15 min.
platform-bot: Metering extract ready: duplicate node-hours = 28 GPU-hours. Billed burst corresponds to 84 GPU-hours. Legit burst should be 56 GPU-hours -> corrected burst = $2,400 (billing rate $42.86/hr).
trevor-fin: OK math: billed $7,200 -> corrected $2,400 -> overcharge $4,800. Propose credit of $4,800.
anna-cs: (typo on name) anna-cs: Customer upset; recommend adding a $500 goodwill credit and expedited refund if payment captured.
trevor-fin: Approve: CN-4019-1 for $4,800 (duplicate-billing-credit) + CN-4019-2 for $500 (goodwill). Tag reason=autoscaler-duplication. Hold collection on INV-4019 until CN applied.
billing-bot: Creating CN-4019-1 ($4,800) and CN-4019-2 ($500). Collection hold placed. Refund queued if payment already taken.
maya: I'll notify ProtonAI and include summary + ETA (24h) for credit posting. Also adding FIN ticket FIN-945: "autoscaler duplication billing audit + preventive fix".
trevor-fin: Please include internal AR note and reverse recognition for overbilled amount.
maya: Noted. Closing — will update when CN posts and customer confirms. :white_check_mark:
